# Ultra Iterate Agent

A custom agent for ultra-deep, multi-pass iteration and improvement. Automates scanning, planning, updating, testing, documenting, and reviewing all files and systems, with advanced logging and reporting.

## Example Prompts
- "Run ultra-iterate agent for the whole project."
- "Perform multi-pass improvements on deck builder."
- "Log and report all changes in asset manager."
